About this item

  • Crafted from food-grade 18/8 stainless steel, the double walled insulated bottle keep your drinks hot for 12 hours and cold for 24 hours.Say goodbye to lukewarm drinks and enjoy refreshing sips of hot or cold beverages whenever you need them
  • The water bottle comes with 3 lids for different beverages, a sip lid for hot drinks, a straw lid for iced beverages, a flex-removable lid(2 different handle lids ship at random) for smoothies or fruit drinks. All lids are BPA-free, leak-proof, and dust-proof, catering to your needs
  • Enjoy a dry grip without any unwanted condensation on the bottle's non-sweat surface. Easy-to-carry design makes it perfect for on-the-go use, the insulated water bottle with straw is a must-have for your daily routine
  • The metal water bottle comes in various sizes, including 18 oz, 22 oz, 24 oz, 32 oz, and 40 oz, with a range of colors to choose from according to your need.
  • The insulated sports water bottle is ideal for outdoor activities, the gym, work, or home use. Carry this water bottle with you wherever you go and stay hydrated all day

Product Description

Konokyo Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle is designed for sports, gym, school, hiking, camping, travel, outdoor activities and daily hydration. The triple-layer insulated stainless steel body helps keep drinks cold for up to 24 hours or hot for up to 12 hours. Made with BPA-free materials and a leak-resistant design, it is easy to carry in a backpack, gym bag or travel bag. Durable and reusable, it is suitable for home, work, school and on-the-go use.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love this water bottle's appearance, with one noting it looks like a more expensive product, and appreciate its portability with the handy carrying strap. The bottle comes with three different lids and effectively keeps water cold throughout the day. However, durability and leakage receive mixed reviews - while some say it doesn't dent and doesn't leak, others report handle breakage within days and leakage issues. Ice retention is also mixed, with some saying it keeps ice all day while others note the ice melts after about an hour.

Super easy to carry with a great handle, easy to unscrew and drink from for his littler hands. Vibrant color, leak proof and keeps water/ice cold all day!     5 out of 5 stars
    AMAZING bottle at an AMAZING Price!!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 12, 2026
    Color: Lake BlueSize: 40 Ounces

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    This water bottle is a dream - everything I wanted in a bottle AND for a price better than anything I've seen anywhere else:

    -Non-straw lids: I personally don't often like to be bothered to clean straws. So to have not one, but two alternative lids to that? Amazing. And if I decide I do want to mess with the straws, there's more than one so they can be rotated, and a brush to clean them as well.

    -Dishwasher safe: I want as few dishes in my life to be hand-wash as possible. The fact that I can just throw this in the dishwasher is absolutely amazing.

    -Great insulating capabilities: I filled this bottle up with ice to the top the first morning, and there was a good amount of the original ice more than 48 hours later (keeping in mind this was all in an indoor setting). I will say I'm not as much of a hot beverage person, so I can't verify about the heating capabilities.

    Stability: The silicone base does it's job great. I will say I am clumsy, so it's not impossible for me to still knock the water bottle over, but that's fine because...

    Seal: The seals on the handle lid and the spout lid both work great. I haven't tried the straw lid, full disclosure, but the other two I have knocked over and had no leaks. I actually turned the bottle completely upside down after I filled it and put the spout lid on for the first time and there were no issues.

    Now of course it doesn't fit in cup holders, but it's a 40 ounce bottle, so that's not surprising, and honestly no big deal for me.

    I’ve been using the Konokyo Insulated Water Bottle and overall it’s a solid, well-thought-out bottle with a lot going for it.

    The biggest plus is how versatile it is. I use it for both hot and cold liquids, and it handles both extremely well. The insulation does its job, keeping drinks at temperature for hours. I also really appreciate that it’s dishwasher safe, which makes cleaning simple and hassle-free.

    Another standout feature is that it comes with three different lids, which gives you flexibility depending on how you’re using it—work, travel, workouts, or just daily hydration. The bottle itself feels very sturdy and durable, like it can handle being tossed into a bag without worry.

    The only downside for me is that it’s a bit tall for my liking, and it does take a little time to get used to handling it. That said, once you adjust, it becomes second nature—and honestly, once you do, you’ll probably end up loving it.

    Overall, this is a reliable, durable, and versatile insulated bottle. A great choice if you want something that works well for both hot and cold drinks and offers flexibility right out of the box.

About this Item

  • Crafted from food-grade 18/8 stainless steel, the double walled insulated bottle keep your drinks hot for 12 hours and cold for 24 hours.Say goodbye to lukewarm drinks and enjoy refreshing sips of hot or cold beverages whenever you need them
  • The water bottle comes with 3 lids for different beverages, a sip lid for hot drinks, a straw lid for iced beverages, a flex-removable lid(2 different handle lids ship at random) for smoothies or fruit drinks. All lids are BPA-free, leak-proof, and dust-proof, catering to your needs
  • Enjoy a dry grip without any unwanted condensation on the bottle's non-sweat surface. Easy-to-carry design makes it perfect for on-the-go use, the insulated water bottle with straw is a must-have for your daily routine
  • The metal water bottle comes in various sizes, including 18 oz, 22 oz, 24 oz, 32 oz, and 40 oz, with a range of colors to choose from according to your need.
  • The insulated sports water bottle is ideal for outdoor activities, the gym, work, or home use. Carry this water bottle with you wherever you go and stay hydrated all day

Product Description

Konokyo Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle is designed for sports, gym, school, hiking, camping, travel, outdoor activities and daily hydration. The triple-layer insulated stainless steel body helps keep drinks cold for up to 24 hours or hot for up to 12 hours. Made with BPA-free materials and a leak-resistant design, it is easy to carry in a backpack, gym bag or travel bag. Durable and reusable, it is suitable for home, work, school and on-the-go use.
